audience: course creators who sell and run online courses on Teachable

useCases.title: Track student progress through a course
useCases.text: List the active students of one course, then read one student's progress through its lectures and sections.

useCases.title: Read the content of a lecture
useCases.text: Get one course to find its lecture ids. Then read the text, attachments and video details of one lecture.

useCases.title: Review recent sales
useCases.text: List the sales transactions of the school. New sales can take up to two minutes to appear.

useCases.title: Find failing webhook deliveries
useCases.text: List the webhooks of the school, then list the delivery attempts of one webhook with their HTTP status codes.

useCases.title: Enroll a user in a course
useCases.text: Find the user by email and the course by id. Then enroll the user. The student gets access at once.

useCases.title: Look up a student and their enrollments
useCases.text: Filter the users by email, then open one user to read the role and enrollments.
